description: Track up to 20 parcels in one call and get a compact table: status per parcel plus counts of delivered / in transit / needs attention. Each item may carry your own reference (orderId) that is echoed back. 여러 운송장을 한 번에 조회합니다. Use after naver_list_orders / coupang_list_orders to answer '오늘 발송분 어디쯤?' or to find stuck parcels. Needs parcels[] of {carrier, trackingNumber, ref?}.
